items.title: Abby Foster Interview, 1960-06-29
items.q: You said that was one of your very first jobs... John was the banjo player.

ctx.x: Some of the Mareros, they stayed with the band, didn't they? Simon and uh... Simon and John.
John was the banjo player. Simon was the bass violin player. Yeah.
Who was the piano then? Jeanette Sullivan.
